problem: Can a liner adapt its stiffness and volume in real time to body shape changes for amputees?
mechanism_or_method: Silicone elastomer with embedded pressurizable millifluidic channels giving spatiotemporally tunable stiffness and volume.
limitation: Only preclinical studies; long-term durability and clinical outcomes unclear.
decision_relevance: Supports adaptive pneumatic liners over fixed-stiffness prosthetic interfaces.

problem: How to efficiently find active and stable high-entropy OER electrocatalyst compositions in a vast compositional space?
mechanism_or_method: Batch-alloy targeting: fuse elements into rough-guess multiphase alloy library and use surface restructuring extent as activity indicator.
limitation: Restructuring as activity proxy validated on a limited system; generality unclear.

object: thermally cross-linked perfluorinated polymer gas separation membranes
problem: How to make microporous membranes resistant to plasticization and aging with high CO2 permeability?
mechanism_or_method: Defluorination-induced thermal cross-linking of perfluorinated aryl-ether-free polymers generates extrinsic micropores and larger intersegmental distances.
limitation: Lab-scale testing; long-term industrial stability under real feeds not shown.

object: peptoid crystalline nanomaterials as carbonic anhydrase mimics
problem: Can assembled peptoid crystals mimic carbonic anhydrase to promote CO2 hydration and sequestration?
mechanism_or_method: Self-assembly of ligand-bearing peptoids coordinated with Zn2+ into nanosheets and nanotubes with controlled active-site microenvironment.
limitation: Comparable only to natural bovine CA; scale-up and real flue gas performance not shown.

problem: Can clothing thickness adapt automatically to sweating to widen thermal regulation range?
mechanism_or_method: Bacterial cellulose membrane filling that thins from 13 mm to 2 mm with humidity and sweat.
limitation: City-level benefit is modeled; wearer trials and durability under washing not reported.
decision_relevance: Favors humidity-responsive fillings over fixed-thickness insulation for cold-climate clothing.

object: Pickering emulsion solvent extraction of lithium from brine
problem: How to raise lithium recovery and Li-Mg selectivity while preventing extractant dissolution?
mechanism_or_method: Amphipathic SiO2 nanoparticles confine TBP in O/W Pickering emulsion; interparticle gaps act as Li+ transport channels.
limitation: Lab-scale extraction; mechanism proposed rather than directly proven; long-term emulsion stability unclear.

object: copper-containing mordenite adsorbent for N2/CH4 separation
problem: How to tune zeolite pore size at 0.1-0.2 Angstrom resolution to sieve nitrogen from methane?
mechanism_or_method: In situ high-temperature crystallization shifts copper position in mordenite, enlarging pore volume and improving N2 uptake kinetics.
limitation: Absolute N2 capacity is low; testing on pure gases and breakthrough only at lab scale.

object: amino acid-modified ice for methane hydrate storage
problem: Can amino acid-modified ice rapidly form methane hydrate with high storage capacity for solidified natural gas?
mechanism_or_method: Amino acids promote hydrate nucleation and growth on ice, tracked with in situ Raman for cage occupancy.
limitation: Lab-scale reactors; scalability only assessed preliminarily and cyclic reuse unclear.
decision_relevance: Suggests additive-modified ice as a faster route to solidified natural gas storage.

object: Ni-V and Ni-Pd single-phase solid solution alloys
problem: Is atomic volume or electronegativity difference the dominant factor in solid solution strengthening of FCC alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Designed Ni-V and Ni-Pd alloys isolating each variable and comparing strengthening versus grain size effects.
limitation: Only two binary Ni-based FCC systems; extension to multicomponent alloys not tested.
decision_relevance: Guides solute selection toward atomic size mismatch in strengthening models.

problem: How to map inner canthi temperature accurately, non-contact, with better pixel allocation than camera thermography?
mechanism_or_method: Single-pixel infrared imaging with cyclic S-matrix transmissive encoding masks and non-iterative reconstruction.
limitation: Small human measurement scale; clinical diagnostic validity not demonstrated.
decision_relevance: May refine fever screening criteria using inner canthi temperature.

problem: How to keep an anti-fog coating effective long-term against cyclic drying, contaminants and weak interfaces?
mechanism_or_method: Twisted non-coplanar phthalazinone structures raise free volume and moisture absorption, combined with photothermal fog removal.
limitation: Laboratory durability tests; outdoor real-world aging not shown.

problem: Can light control redox switching of hydrogels to give spatiotemporal precision for actuation?
mechanism_or_method: Bisthioxanthylidene switch in hydrogel whose two-electron oxidation potential is modulated by light, patterned by photo-masking.
limitation: Proof-of-principle; actuation forces and speeds modest and long-term cycling unclear.

problem: How to increase TENG output when densifying triboelectric layers despite charge cancellation and shielding?
mechanism_or_method: Charge dispatch strategy via path diversion and mode transformation, laser etching, contact push pins, and magnetic repulsion pendulum.
limitation: Lab-scale wave excitation; long-term wear and marine durability not reported.
decision_relevance: Guides layer-density and pendulum design for low-frequency wave energy harvesters.

problem: How to synthesize monodisperse multicomponent HEO hollow nanocubes despite disparate nucleation and growth kinetics?
mechanism_or_method: Template-assisted coordinating etching with selected etchant at room temperature to build ternary to octonary libraries.
limitation: Applications only implied; functional performance not evaluated in the abstract.

problem: How do gradient microstructures around dendrites affect strength-ductility, and can they be programmed?
mechanism_or_method: Unified trigonometric function describing gradient microstructures, with high-throughput simulations linking gradient intensity to properties.
limitation: Trigonometric gradient description tied to specific AM single-crystal alloys; wider validation unclear.
decision_relevance: Guides tuning of AM process gradients to tailor strength and ductility.

problem: Can mechanical vibration replace heat to extract water from sorbents at lower energy than evaporation enthalpy?
mechanism_or_method: Ultrasonic vibrational actuation extracts adsorbed water from moisture harvesting materials without thermal evaporation.
limitation: Bench-scale extraction; system-level energy including adsorption and ultrasound hardware at scale unproven.
decision_relevance: Suggests ultrasonic extraction over thermal desorption for low-energy water harvesting.

object: laser-induced melting of tungsten and gold nanofilms
problem: How does extreme electron-ion non-equilibrium change melting mechanisms in ultrafast laser-excited metals?
mechanism_or_method: Neural network-enhanced multiscale simulation showing electronic pressure relaxation drives surface-initiated heterogeneous melting.
limitation: Purely simulated; awaits time-resolved X-ray diffraction experimental confirmation.

problem: Can oxygen clusters avoid inverse Hall-Petch softening in nanograined metals while retaining plasticity?
mechanism_or_method: O-rich clusters at grain boundaries stabilize them and clusters in grains promote dislocation multiplication and strain hardening.
limitation: Micropillar compression on a thin-film model alloy; bulk scalability unclear.
decision_relevance: Suggests solute clustering for nanocrystalline strength design.

object: 3D-printed CoCrNi medium-entropy alloy with TiC precipitates
problem: How to introduce controlled nano-precipitates in AM alloys despite the narrow laser thermal window?
mechanism_or_method: CoCrNi core powders decorated with TiC shell nanoparticles dissolve at first laser pulse and reprecipitate in situ on cyclic reheating.
limitation: Demonstrated for one alloy system; fatigue and large part build quality not reported.
decision_relevance: Favors composite powder feedstock for precipitation strengthening in laser AM.

object: shape-memory hydrogel substrates for implantable bioelectronics
problem: How to program trigger-free shapeshifting with predefined onset times in hydrogel substrates?
mechanism_or_method: Digital light 4D printing with spatiotemporal exposure creating heterogeneous networks and thermally induced phase separation delays.
limitation: Mouse in-vivo only for biocompatibility; implantation shape recovery in tissue not shown.

problem: How to morph closed surfaces in shape, size and topology with programmed bistability?
mechanism_or_method: Balanced integration of origami crease rotation and kirigami hinge rotation in panel assemblages.
limitation: Prototype-scale demonstrations; actuation and load-bearing capability not addressed in the abstract.

problem: How to get high EMI shielding and load-bearing in a lightweight magnesium composite?
mechanism_or_method: Preconstructed 3D pristine graphene@pyrocarbon skeleton infiltrated with molten AZ91D and retained by liquid-solid infiltration extrusion.
limitation: Lab-scale samples; fatigue, corrosion and scalability not addressed.

object: MOF-LiCl composite sorbent for solar atmospheric water harvesting
problem: How to lower desorption temperature and use nighttime humidity better in solar atmospheric water harvesting?
mechanism_or_method: Composite of LiCl with Ni2Cl2(BTDD) MOF combining low vaporization enthalpy and high stable capacity.
limitation: Field tests short; MOF cost and long-term salt leakage stability unclear.
decision_relevance: Supports hybrid salt-MOF sorbents for lower-temperature desorption devices.

problem: How much warming do air-conditioning related emissions cause, and how do climate and income drive them?
mechanism_or_method: Scenario-based global quantification of AC emissions and temperature impact, separating climate and socio-economic contributions.
limitation: Scenario-dependent projections with uncertain AC ownership and use assumptions.
decision_relevance: Argues for prioritizing low-carbon, efficient cooling policy as incomes rise.

object: ZSM-5 nanorod array films on monoliths
problem: How to speed propene sorption kinetics without losing capacity in porous materials?
mechanism_or_method: Oriented single-crystalline ZSM-5 nanorod arrays on monoliths, optionally combined with Co3O4 nanoarrays for removal.
limitation: Lab-scale simple gas tests; realistic exhaust conditions with water and poisons not shown.

object: vacancy-rich titania monolayers for proton transport
problem: Can 2D titania monolayers deliver high proton conductivity while blocking other species?
mechanism_or_method: Dense titanium vacancies (about one per square nm) make the monolayer an angstrom-scale proton sieve.
limitation: Monolayer devices at small scale; large-area membranes and long-term durability not shown.

problem: How to design a light, strong alloy with high He-ion irradiation resistance?
mechanism_or_method: High-throughput design producing high-content beta-Nb5Si3 phase with prefabricated lattice distortion and semi-coherent interfaces, supported by DFT.
limitation: Ion irradiation is a surrogate for neutron damage; room-temperature ductility not highlighted.

object: silica precipitation in a granite fracture
problem: How does silica precipitation alter permeability and fluid pressure in fractures relevant to earthquake cycles?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrothermal flow-through experiments at constant flow rate recording inlet-outlet pressure oscillations from repeated blockage and failure of sealed layers.
limitation: Small laboratory slit with high supersaturation; link to natural earthquake rupture inferred.

problem: How to combine rigid inorganic and ductile organic components in bulk materials with switchable stiffness and elasticity?
mechanism_or_method: Inorganic nanoparticles trapped in long-chain polymer networks and anchored by short-chain organic crosslinkers.
limitation: Clinical suitability only tested in small rat and in vitro studies; long-term behavior unclear.

object: nanoscale friction between Ir AFM tip and graphene
problem: Can alternating electric current reduce nanoscale friction and wear by modulating interfacial electronic properties?
mechanism_or_method: 1 kHz alternating current induces dynamic electron density redistribution, quantified by an electronic-level friction model (PTT-E).
limitation: Single AFM tip-graphene system at nanoscale; macroscale transferability unproven.
decision_relevance: Suggests current modulation as a friction-control option in nanomechanical devices.

object: battery-grade nickel and cobalt sulfate production from sulfide resources
problem: Can nickel and cobalt sulfates be produced from complex sulfide resources without acid leaching?
mechanism_or_method: Acid-free process for processing complex sulfide resources with technoeconomic and carbon emission analysis.
limitation: Abstract truncated; process details and pilot-scale validation unclear.

problem: How to automatically design wireframe DNA nanostructures without a scaffold strand and its size limits?
mechanism_or_method: BRAIDS pipeline generating short intertwined oligonucleotide designs from 2D and 3D mesh models.
limitation: Experimental folding yield and structural precision of designs not quantified in the abstract.

object: 3D hydrogel platform for mechanical stimulation of cancer cells
problem: How do force magnitude, frequency and duration through specific integrins affect cancer spheroid migration and invasion?
mechanism_or_method: Near-infrared-responsive macromolecular actuators in a 3D hydrogel apply integrin-specific forces, supported by molecular simulations.
limitation: In vitro ovarian cancer spheroids only; in vivo relevance not shown.

problem: Can functional ceramics be made foldable while keeping high permittivity?
mechanism_or_method: Crystalline/amorphous microstructure in high-entropy ceramic film enabling 180 degree folding and flexible capacitors.
limitation: Abstract truncated; fatigue over many folds and large-area processing unclear.

problem: How to make muscle rings generate sustained high contractile force under tetanus for biohybrid robots?
mechanism_or_method: Stiffer pillar supports and denser myoblasts with less extracellular matrix, plus C-shaped anchors converting force into bending.
limitation: Cultured muscle requires medium and electrical stimulation; endurance and untethered operation limited.

object: insect-scale soft robots with electromagnetic muscle-like actuators
problem: Can a low-voltage muscle-like actuator power onboard autonomous insect-scale soft robots?
mechanism_or_method: Elasto-electromagnetic mechanism using structured elastomers with magnetic forces, holding states without continuous power.
limitation: Small-scale prototypes; payload, endurance and onboard battery life limited.
decision_relevance: Favors elasto-electromagnetic actuators for small untethered low-voltage robots.

object: magnetically actuated fiberbot for knee laser surgery
problem: Can a flexible magnetic fiber deliver steerable mid-infrared laser ablation in minimally invasive knee surgery?
mechanism_or_method: Multicore fiber for mid-infrared laser delivery encased in magnetic elastomer, steered by external magnetic field.
limitation: Tested on phantom, isolated pig joint and rat bone; human surgical feasibility unproven.

object: imaging Mueller matrix spectroscopic ellipsometer for wafer metrology
problem: How to measure semiconductor structures densely across a whole wafer with high throughput?
mechanism_or_method: Ultra-wide-field 20x20 mm imaging ellipsometry with signal correction and machine learning for spatially dense metrology.
limitation: Needs custom optical system; accuracy relative to reference methods only shown for DRAM structures.
decision_relevance: Supports wafer-wide optical metrology over point-based SEM sampling for yield monitoring.

object: ionic covalent organic framework membranes with Turing patterns
problem: How to get self-standing COF membranes that are both highly crystalline and mechanically strong?
mechanism_or_method: Inorganic ion regulation of interfacial polymerization giving reaction-diffusion Turing architecture, studied by MD, DFT and experiments.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; separation performance and scalability not quantified in the abstract.

problem: Can lithium be separated from ore in one acid-free, alkali-free step within seconds?
mechanism_or_method: Flash Joule heating of alpha-spodumene under Cl2 distills LiCl away from non-volatile aluminum and silicon oxides.
limitation: Small-batch lab reactor with chlorine handling; scale-up and process economics not demonstrated.

problem: How to program toughness and stiffness in hydrogels in space and time?
mechanism_or_method: Latent ionic cross-linking from printed CaCO3 microparticles, triggered on demand by glucono-delta-lactone acidifier.
limitation: Demonstrations are lab-scale; long-term stability of calcium-crosslinked gels and fatigue not addressed.

problem: How to miniaturize fully soft steering for everting robots with multiple large bends?
mechanism_or_method: Robot skin functionalized with liquid crystal elastomer actuators controlled by internal pressure and actuator temperature.
limitation: Thermal actuation response is slow and surgical or inspection use only demonstrated in lab.

object: carbon nanofiber air filters for direct air capture
problem: Can distributed CO2 capture filters in ventilation systems remove CO2 cheaply with low-energy regeneration?
mechanism_or_method: Carbon nanofiber adsorbent filters regenerated by solar thermal or electrothermal heating, evaluated with life cycle and techno-economic analysis.
limitation: Global removal potential is modeled; cost range is wide and real building trials absent.
decision_relevance: Supports integrating DAC filters into building ventilation rather than centralized plants.

problem: Can temporal refraction and reflection of flexural waves be realized experimentally in an elastic beam?
mechanism_or_method: Array of piezoelectric patches switching effective elastic properties in time, verified against temporal Snell's law and Fresnel equations.
limitation: Laboratory beam with limited modulation speed and bandwidth; practical phononic devices not shown.

problem: How does cation size mismatch govern oxygen vacancy formation in high-entropy perovskites?
mechanism_or_method: Measured vacancy concentrations in fourteen perovskites plus machine-learned interatomic potential simulations and statistical thermodynamics of vacancy energy distributions.
limitation: Limited to A-site compositions studied; electrode performance in devices not tested.

problem: How to build flexible sensing elastomers stable and sensitive at cryogenic temperatures?
mechanism_or_method: Fluorine-rich supramolecular polyurethane with electrostatic crosslinks and fluorine-dipole interactions with ionic liquid stabilizing ion transport.
limitation: Long-term durability and ionic liquid leakage under extreme cycling not reported.

problem: Why does GRX-810 show exceptional tensile, creep and oxidation performance above 1100 C?
mechanism_or_method: High-temperature tensile, creep and thermal cycling tests with atomic-scale characterization and atomistic modeling of fine trigonal yttrium oxides.
limitation: Single alloy; creep lives and oxidation over long service durations not covered.
decision_relevance: Supports ODS additive alloys for service above 1100 C.

object: nanosheet-bridged ZIF-8 membranes for propylene/propane separation
problem: How to make MOF membranes mechanically robust at high pressure without cracking at grain boundaries?
mechanism_or_method: Graphene oxide nanosheets bridge soft MOF grains like a cuttlebone wall, dispersing stress at grain boundaries.
limitation: Tested to 300 hours at lab scale; long-term industrial stream performance not proven.

object: COF-PEEK nanofiber membranes for oily water separation
problem: How to raise strength, stability and hydrophilicity of polymeric nanofiber membranes under harsh conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Sequential crystallization inserts a COF nanoarray layer into PEEK nanofibers forming a mechanical interlocking structure.
limitation: Lab-scale emulsions; tensile strength modest at 16.2 MPa and scale-up unclear.

problem: How to optimize fracture toughness and high-temperature strength simultaneously in Nb-Si alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Machine learning with three-step feature screening, SHAP analysis and NSGA-II multi-objective optimization, followed by alloy synthesis and microstructure analysis.
limitation: Only as-cast properties reported; heat-treated and oxidation performance not covered.
decision_relevance: Supports ML-guided composition selection for as-cast Nb-Si alloys.

problem: Can sound achieve displacement resolution far below the half-wavelength diffraction limit?
mechanism_or_method: Topological pairs in spiral-twisted orbital meta-atoms produce interference giving an acoustic analogue of Malus's law.
limitation: Prototype at audible frequency with large 100 mm wavelength; robustness in real environments untested.

problem: Can a soft device achieve autonomous snapping and environmental sensing under constant light?
mechanism_or_method: Elastic snap-through instability embedded in a liquid crystalline network driven out of equilibrium by continuous light energy transfer.
limitation: Laboratory light source needed; sensing demonstrated for simple cues only.

problem: How to explore centimeter-scale cavities of varying shapes with a simple adaptive soft robot?
mechanism_or_method: Inflatable pufferfish-inspired skin with flexible spikes creating asymmetric friction under vibration, propelling without feedback control.
limitation: Tested in laboratory pipe mockups; fouled or live pipelines and tethering not addressed.
decision_relevance: Favors simple vibration-driven morphing robots for inspecting variable-diameter small pipes.

problem: How to get high-capacity hysteresis-free water sorption under very dry conditions?
mechanism_or_method: Post-synthetic cation exchange in SU-102 with trends probed by vibrational Stark spectroscopy following a Hofmeister-type series.
limitation: 500 cycles at lab scale; cost of zirconium ellagic acid MOF and device performance unclear.

object: water-soluble polyacrylamide precursor for carbon fibre
problem: Can carbon fibre be made from an aqueous precursor with lower energy and emissions than PAN?
mechanism_or_method: Aqueous polyacrylamide dry-spun fibres with phosphoric acid shortening thermal stabilisation and raising carbon yield.
limitation: Lab-scale fibre spinning; strength matches PAN-CF only at comparable level and industrial scale-up unproven.
decision_relevance: May favor aqueous precursors to cut solvent use and stabilisation energy in carbon fibre production.

problem: Can a tough underwater soft robot navigate by light without photo-mechanically responsive materials?
mechanism_or_method: Polymer gel not photo-responsive itself, powered by ambient fluid effects under light, enabling phototactic 3D multimodal locomotion.
limitation: Mechanism of fluid-powered propulsion and efficiency not detailed in abstract; lab tank demonstrations only.

object: photoresponsive organic crystals forming quasicircular microcrystals
problem: How to obtain elastic circular organic microcrystals in a controllable way?
mechanism_or_method: Light-induced bending, photosalient effect and delamination of a parent organic crystal, tuned by wavelength and power.
limitation: Single crystalline material; optical properties of resulting crystals not yet explored.

problem: How do curing time and temperature control interfacial adhesion and failure mode in silicone elastomers?
mechanism_or_method: Dimensionless reaction coordinate coupling time and temperature predicts adhesion strength and transition from bulk fracture to adhesive failure.
limitation: Shown for silicone elastomers only; other chemistries and long-term adhesion aging not addressed.
decision_relevance: Sets cure time and temperature windows for robust interfaces in cast and printed soft devices.

problem: How to combine dynamic and static tactile sensing with rapid mode switching and wide pressure range?
mechanism_or_method: All-in-one structure switching modes in 1 ms by light modulation, with closed-loop feedback and deep learning for haptic Morse code.
limitation: Demonstrations are prototype-level; robustness and user studies are limited.

object: multistable thin-shell metastructures for reconfigurable robots
problem: Can multistable thin-shell metastructures create highly reconfigurable adaptive robots?
mechanism_or_method: Developable surface thin polymer sheets with patterned cutouts storing elastic energy, giving up to 20 stable states per unit, combined with magnetic and electroactive actuators.
limitation: Prototype-scale grippers and crawlers; payload and cycle life not reported.
